verdict.rationale: Baseten documents a deprecation policy for Model APIs, instructing users to migrate to dedicated deployments when weights are deprecated (baseten-docs-12), showing some commitment to managing API lifecycle. However, there is no evidence of explicit API versioning (e.g., version numbers, changelogs) and probes for an OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404s, suggesting no formal versioned API contract is published. Missing for 10: explicit API version scheme, published changelog, machine-readable API spec, and independent confirmation of deprecation timelines.
